name: akbun-makevideo
description: Edit, check and render the running akbun-makevideo timeline from an AI client.
long_description: Runs locally and talks to the open akbun-makevideo editor over a user-only Unix socket. No account, token or network port. Every edit is one undo step with a recovery checkpoint taken first. The editor must be installed; launch_app opens it when it is closed.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check whether the editor is running, its version, revision, render state and proxy progress.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Open the installed editor on macOS and wait until it answers.

tools.name: editing_guide
tools.description: Read command formats, timing rules and recovery workflow before editing.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read the current project, asset/track/item IDs, captions, revision and stateToken.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the editor workspace.

tools.name: new_project
tools.description: Start a blank project.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open an .akbunvideo file.

tools.name: import_media
tools.description: Probe and reference existing local video/audio/image files in the project.

tools.name: preview_edits
tools.description: Validate a command batch without changing the project.

tools.name: apply_edits
tools.description: Apply a command batch immediately as one undo step.

tools.name: create_checkpoint
tools.description: Remember the current project before a multi-step task.

tools.name: list_checkpoints
tools.description: List the newest 100 persistent recovery points.

tools.name: restore_checkpoint
tools.description: Restore a whole project from a recovery point.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the most recent editor operation, including manual edits.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone editor operation.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Atomically save as .akbunvideo.

tools.name: sample_asset
tools.description: Return up to 8 JPEG frames from an imported video interval of at most 60 seconds, or one frame for an image.

tools.name: get_library
tools.description: Read saved reusable graphic templates and B-roll observations.

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Start rendering to a NEW video path using existing ffmpeg/render settings.

tools.name: render_status
tools.description: Read current export state and its completion result.

tools.name: cancel_render
tools.description: Request cancellation of the running export.
